CaseTypeAction.description: What a decision may set in motion; each chosen action becomes a task.
CaseTypeAction.title: CaseTypeAction

CaseTypeField.description: A structured field of the case, filterable in the queue.
CaseTypeField.title: CaseTypeField

CaseTypeOutcome.description: A result the decision can record (06 §1).
CaseTypeOutcome.title: CaseTypeOutcome

CaseTypeSla.description: Hours of each phase, counted from the alert (else the occurrence, else the creation).
CaseTypeSla.title: CaseTypeSla

CaseTypeTraceDefaults.description: What "Follow the money" starts with on a case of this type (06 §3c).
CaseTypeTraceDefaults.title: CaseTypeTraceDefaults

TemplateParameter.description: A parameter for a query template.
TemplateParameter.title: TemplateParameter

case_type_schema.description:
An admin-defined kind of case (06 §1): its vocabulary, its decisions and
actions, its fields, deadlines and what the agent reads first. Data, not code.
case_type_schema.title: CaseTypeSpec

report_placeholders.description: the alert or ticket id that opened the case
one field of the case type (money with two decimals)
every field of the case type, a bullet list label: value
the date and time of the rendering
every decision, a bullet list (D1 · outcome on targets — who, when)
when the last decision was recorded
the entities the last decision is about, or 'the whole case'
the last decision's review state (pending, approved, rejected), or —
the pinned versions, E1, E2… with their sha256, a bullet list
the confirmed hypotheses with their status, a bullet list
the entities with a confirmed role (entity — role), a bullet list
the open tasks with assignee and due time, a bullet list

enrichment_schema.description:
How a ``table`` item with ``mapping.as = enrichment`` joins the case's
nodes: rows keyed by ``key_column``; a node of ``match_node_types`` matches
by its id or a property, reduced to its first ``key_digits`` digits when set
(a company id against its group prefix in a registry).
enrichment_schema.title: FileEnrichmentSpec

agent_tools.name: add_document
agent_tools.summary: A document: markdown ``text`` (document/markdown) or a ``url`` (document/link).

agent_tools.name: add_item
agent_tools.summary: Generic add: any kind/subkind, or a new version of ``item_id`` (text or content_json).

agent_tools.name: add_note
agent_tools.summary: A markdown note, free or anchored on entities (unified ids).

agent_tools.name: add_table
agent_tools.summary: A table (table/result) from columns and rows, e.g.

agent_tools.name: add_task
agent_tools.summary: A follow-up on the case: for a person (``assignee`` e-mail) or an agent (``assignee_kind="agent"``, ``agent_name`` = the token name that should pick it up; empty = any agent).

agent_tools.name: annotate
agent_tools.summary: Annotate entities or items: role {"role"} on one entity (values from the case's settings.vocabularies.roles), tag {"tag"}, same_as on [keep, drop], hypothesis {"text", "status"?}, hypothesis_status {"status": open | supported | refuted} on a hypothesis id.

agent_tools.name: changes_since
agent_tools.summary: What changed since an ISO 8601 timestamp (everything when omitted): journal events, items created or with a new version, annotations.

agent_tools.name: compare_tables
agent_tools.summary: Diff by key of two tables, or of two runs of one query (same item, two versions): rows only on one side, rows whose shared columns changed, how many are the same.

agent_tools.name: create_case
agent_tools.summary: Open a new case owned by the person you act for.

agent_tools.name: create_exploration
agent_tools.summary: Start a new exploration in a readable context and attach it to the case as a live reference; returns ``url`` for the person to open (``/graph/{context}?exploration=…&case=…``).

agent_tools.name: find_entity_cases
agent_tools.summary: Where else this entity shows up: the cases you read where ``uid`` (an entity id from get_graph or search_entities, e.g.

agent_tools.name: get_brief
agent_tools.summary: The case brief (markdown) and its item with versions.

agent_tools.name: get_case
agent_tools.summary: Case summary: status and stage, its case type (label, outcomes, actions, fields, stages, notice, playbook), its fields, tags, settings (vocabularies, agent_suggest_kinds), deadline, the decisions so far (outcome, targets, review, hash), the confirmed roles and the counts of items, suggestions and entities.

agent_tools.name: get_case_type
agent_tools.summary: The org's case types (slug, label, description) when ``slug`` is omitted; one type in full otherwise: vocabularies (roles, tags, link_attributes), outcomes and actions of its decisions, its fields (what create_case needs), stages, SLA hours, notice and playbook.

agent_tools.name: get_entity
agent_tools.summary: One entity: properties, the items it came from, its confirmed role, the annotations and notes anchored on it, and its edges.

agent_tools.name: get_graph
agent_tools.summary: The unified case graph (identity keys and confirmed same_as applied), or one graph item's with ``item_id``.

agent_tools.name: get_playbook
agent_tools.summary: A doc of the org library by slug — a playbook (markdown steps), a report template (render_report uses it) or a saved file mapping (JSON) — or the list of slugs, titles and kinds when omitted.

agent_tools.name: group
agent_tools.summary: Groups of entities (05 §5).

agent_tools.name: import_file
agent_tools.summary: Import a delimited or fixed-width text file as a table/csv item, with the text inline (up to about 4 MB; convert other formats to CSV first).

agent_tools.name: join_tables
agent_tools.summary: Join two or more tables of the case by a key column (the first shared column when omitted) into a new table item whose provenance names its parents.

agent_tools.name: list_annotations
agent_tools.summary: Annotations (role, tag, group, same_as, hypothesis, hypothesis_status, status_change, task, decision_proposal) with status, author and reason; ``target`` filters by entity or item id.

agent_tools.name: list_cases
agent_tools.summary: A page of the cases you can read: ``items`` (id, title, status, case_type, fields, deadline, item and suggestion counts), ``total`` and ``counts``.

agent_tools.name: list_events
agent_tools.summary: The case journal, oldest first; ``after`` is the last event id you saw.

agent_tools.name: list_items
agent_tools.summary: The case material: items of kind graph | table | query | document | note with author, status (suggested | confirmed | rejected), latest version and pins.

agent_tools.name: list_tasks
agent_tools.summary: Your work: tasks assigned to agents under this token's name (or to any agent) across the cases you read, oldest due first, each with its case.

agent_tools.name: lookup_enrichment
agent_tools.summary: Rows of enrichment table ``table`` (a name from the item's context ``enrichment_tables``, e.g.

agent_tools.name: pin_evidence
agent_tools.summary: Pin a version of an item as evidence (immutable; the current one by default; a live exploration is frozen first).

agent_tools.name: promote_tables
agent_tools.summary: Promote tables (or the latest run of queries) to the graph (as_="graph": source_column, target_column, source_type, target_type, edge_type, normalize, amount_prop, time_prop) or to enrichment (as_="enrichment": key_column, match_node_types, match_source).

agent_tools.name: propose_decision
agent_tools.summary: Propose the decision; a person records it (you never decide).

agent_tools.name: read_item
agent_tools.summary: One item with its versions and the text of a version (latest by default): markdown, csv, json, extracted PDF/DOCX text; ``text`` is null when the format has none.

agent_tools.name: render_report
agent_tools.summary: Draft a report from an org template (a memo, a regulator narrative, a letter): the case's values fill its {{placeholders}} and the result is a markdown document a person approves (it arrives suggested).

agent_tools.name: run_analysis
agent_tools.summary: The analyses of the workspace on the unified graph.

agent_tools.name: run_query
agent_tools.summary: Run a saved query item against its context; the result becomes a new version with ``run`` (statement id, duration, rows, parameters).

agent_tools.name: save_query
agent_tools.summary: Save a query of the case (sql | cypher) against a context you can read, with ``:name`` parameters declared like a template's.

agent_tools.name: search_case
agent_tools.summary: Items whose title, description, tags, query or text contain ``q`` (case-insensitive), with a snippet when the hit is in the text.

agent_tools.name: search_entities
agent_tools.summary: Entities whose id, type or properties contain ``query`` (case-insensitive).

agent_tools.name: update_case
agent_tools.summary: Edit title, description, tags or fields (merged; a null removes one), the stage (one of the type's stages), or move the status (open ⇄ analysis).

agent_tools.name: update_item
agent_tools.summary: Edit an item's title, description or tags (content changes are new versions: add_item with item_id).

agent_tools.name: update_task
agent_tools.summary: Move a task you wrote or that is assigned to you (agent): ``state`` done | cancelled | open, a new ``title`` or ``due_at``; ``note`` says what was done (kept as the task's reason).

agent_tools.name: write_brief
agent_tools.summary: Write the case brief (markdown): a new version of the brief item, attributed to you.
